text:
maria: Quick idea — add a one-click 'Quick Save' in Console that captures current route + model + active filters/timeframe. Minimal modal, ships fast, should boost saved-view usage. :sparkles:
dan: Love the UX but worried about telemetry volume. If Quick Save auto-applies or refreshes, we could blow up sampling. Need origin tag + sample_rate on save events.
raj: API note — we'll need a clear saved_query resource shape. Fields: owner, scope (route|model|org), visibility (private|team|public), filters_blob, pinned_model_id, version. Also support `apply_count` for telemetry.
olivia: Rollout idea — start as non-pinned quick-saves (ephemeral) with an option to convert to full Saved View. Show a dotted star vs filled star to distinguish.
alice: Quota concern: saved views that include `auto-refresh: true` can cause background query churn. We should disallow auto-refresh on Quick Save or enforce a throttled refresh policy per-route.
maria: Proposed telemetry keys on save event: `origin=console_quicksave`, `sample_rate`, `scope`, `route_id`, `model_id`, `filters_hash`. That should let us measure adoption without storing raw filters in metrics.
dan: Backend note — we have `/api/savedqueries` v2 but its scope enum is limited. I can extend it to include `quick` flag. Migration: keep current saved queries untouched.
raj: Draft schema (pseudo):
```json
{
  "id": "string",
  "owner": "user_id",
  "scope": "route|model|org",
  "visibility": "private|team|public",
  "filters_blob": "string (json)",
  "pinned_model_id": "string|null",
  "is_quick": true|false,
  "created_at": "ts",
  "telemetry_meta": {"origin":"string","sampling":"float"}
}
```
raj: Also recommend `etag`/`version` to avoid accidental overwrites when converting quick->saved.
olivia: UX question — should Quick Save be scoped to the current route by default? i.e., when you hit Quick Save on a route page it should default scope=route.
maria: yes default to route, allow a dropdown to widen to model/org. Keep modal tiny.
alice: For quotas add server-side check: when converting quick -> shared, validate estimated query cost per minute and require owner consent if above threshold.
dan: For telemetry sampling I'd prefer client-side sampled events plus server-side double-check. We can add `x-sample-hash` header to requests so telemetry and logs can be tied with low cardinality.
console-bot: deploy: started rollout 'quicksave-ui' to staging (feature/quicksave) — 3 services updated.
maria: Nice. Can folks review the modal copy and the API change by EOD? I'll sketch the tiny modal in Fig and send a screenshot.
olivia: Quick UX nit: show a small cost preview line in modal ("estimated 1 query/min if pinned") so folks understand impact.
dan: ack, will add cost preview data to `/api/savedqueries/preview` endpoint.
alice: I'll add quota guard tickets and a policy doc stub.
maria: thanks all — moving this to a short RFC thread and we'll ship a canary to 10% of orgs first. :shipit:
